description: Turn construction notes, photos, measurements, and customer requests into clearer scopes, estimates, proposals, schedules, risk reviews, and project documentation.

defaultPrompt: Create a scope and estimate from my construction notes.
Review these project photos for risks and missing details.
Draft a customer-ready proposal and project schedule.
interface.longDescription: A practical construction workflow for builders, remodelers, general contractors, specialty contractors, estimators, and project managers. BidBuilder organizes field notes, photos, measurements, and customer requests into professional work products while separating verified facts from assumptions, flagging safety and compliance concerns, and protecting scope clarity and contractor profitability.

name: bidbuilder
